record.question: Which city is called 'City of Skyscrapers'?
record.explanation: Answer C: New York. New York is the traditional City of Skyscrapers among these choices. Yung Wing's original 1909 memoir describes Manhattan as a city of skyscrapers, documenting the historical usage. This is a conventional epithet, not an assertion that no other city has skyscrapers. Historical/source note: Traditional historical nickname among these choices; not a claim that only New York has skyscrapers or leads every modern skyscraper count. Reference: https://www.gutenberg.org/files/54635/54635-h/54635-h.htm. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
